ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If water fleas were eliminated from this ecosystem, what animal would be directly affected?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an ecosystem food web diagram. In the lower left there is an organism labeled “water flea”; in the diagram, from its position there is an arrow pointing to the fish toward the upper left, and the fish's label is “southern pygmy perch”. Reasoning: The question asks if water fleas disappear from the ecosystem, which animal will be directly affected. According to the arrow relationship in the food web, the water flea points directly to southern pygmy perch, indicating that this fish directly eats or depends on water fleas. Therefore the directly affected animal is southern pygmy perch.
